texts: On day 17 of Year 1, Pell told Coraline Ash at midnight that weaker lanterns draw fewer nightmoths.
Pell told Coraline Ash that fewer nightmoths leave fewer silken threads.
Pell told Coraline Ash that fewer silken threads yield less mire-essence.
Coraline Ash wrote in the notebook that the lantern, the nightmoths, the silken threads and the mire-essence form a closed loop.

q1_issues.issue: The sealed complement (Draw lantern nightmoth) silently drops both comparative qualifiers - "weaker" lanterns and "fewer" nightmoths - turning an unencodable covariation into an unqualified kind-level claim that lanterns draw nightmoths, which Core patterns forbids ("an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion").

The kind-level-relation route is not triggered here: it requires both arguments to be bare kind-denoting NPs, and an adjectivally-restricted kind subject ("weaker lanterns") is explicitly routed to the distributing-rule form instead.

(Leave nightmoth silken_thread) likewise drops "fewer" on both arguments, asserting inside the seal that nightmoths leave silken threads rather than the stated proportional covariation, and again takes the barred kind-relation route.
(Yield silken_thread mire_essence) drops "fewer" and "less", asserting inside the seal a plain kind relation the sentence does not state.

q2_gaps: Generic covariation stated with elided-standard comparatives / comparative quantifiers on both arguments ("weaker lanterns draw fewer nightmoths", "fewer nightmoths leave fewer silken threads", "fewer silken threads yield less mire-essence"): the comparative-correlative rule requires the "the ADJ-er X, the ADJ-er Y" surface, the attributive/elided-standard comparative rule says to drop the comparative and record a gap, and "fewer/less N" as a bare generic NP has no quantifier carrier (QuantifierPhrase covers proportion words, CardinalityPhrase needs a specific group), so the claim these three sentences actually make has no licensed form at all.
review.notes: Draw / Leave / Yield are lexical kind-relation heads that the relational-generic construction licenses in principle, so they are reported under q1 (wrong construction for these restricted arguments) rather than as invented heads. The attitude scaffolding is otherwise correct throughout - Experiencer holder, Recipient addressee, sealed Theme, past tense and Day/Year/midnight terms, definite typing and compound-decomposition atoms projected at top level, and the indefinite "a closed loop" kept inside the seal.

issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated qualifier ('an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion'), yet (Theme sk_tell_1 (Draw lantern nightmoth)) records Pell as having said that lanterns draw nightmoths, which is false of what he said and widens the claim by discarding both 'weaker' and 'fewer'.

Striking & relational generics limits the kind-level relation to 'both arguments being bare kind-denoting NPs' and states that an adjectivally-restricted kind subject forces the distributing-rule route instead, so 'weaker lanterns' / 'fewer nightmoths' take a route the instruction set explicitly bars.

(Leave nightmoth silken_thread) asserts as Pell's content a bare kind relation the sentence does not state and whose trigger is unmet, since 'fewer nightmoths' and 'fewer silken threads' are comparative-quantified, not bare kind-denoting NPs.
(Yield silken_thread mire_essence) does the same for the third report, dropping 'fewer' and 'less' and seating a kind relation whose both-bare-arguments trigger is unmet.

gaps_confirmed: Generic covariation stated with elided-standard comparatives and comparative quantifiers on both sides ('weaker lanterns draw fewer nightmoths'): the comparative-correlative rule needs the 'the ADJ-er X, the ADJ-er Y' surface, an elided-standard comparative has no second More slot and must be dropped, and 'fewer/less N' as a bare generic has no quantifier carrier (QuantifierPhrase takes proportion words, CardinalityPhrase needs a specific group) - so the claim has no licensed form.
new_gaps: Cross-kind covariation has no carrier even in rule form: the comparative-correlative Implication in the instruction set relates two orderings over ONE domain noun ($x and $y both wine), so a covariation whose two varying quantities belong to different kinds (lantern strength vs. number of nightmoths drawn) cannot be expressed at all; a licensed form would need to reify the linking event and compare its argument groups across two bindings.

An attitude complement that is wholly unencodable for a NON-polarity reason has no stated fallback: the instruction set licenses dropping the Theme and letting the attitude event stand only for a 'wholly negative' complement, so whether the tell event should stand Theme-less here, or the whole report be omitted, is undecided.

The comparative quantifiers 'fewer N' / 'less N' as bare generic NPs have no slot anywhere in the vocabulary - not as strength (they state no proportion), not as QuantifierPhrase (whose companion may only restate a range the rule itself quantifies), and not as CardinalityPhrase (which needs a specific group).
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form would have to carry 'weaker' and 'fewer' inside the seal, and none is licensed - the comparative-correlative rule's surface trigger and single-domain-noun shape do not fit, and an elided-standard comparative must be dropped - so the compliant parse is the tell event with its Experiencer / Recipient / Past / Day / Year / midnight atoms and NO Theme, with the loss recorded as a gap. Issue 1: with the kind-relation route barred and the distributing-rule route unable to carry a standard-less 'weaker', there is no licensed form for this clause at all. Issue 2: same verdict for 'fewer nightmoths leave fewer silken threads' - the second tell event stands with no Theme, since neither a kind relation nor a distributing rule can carry 'fewer' on both arguments. Issue 3: same for 'fewer silken threads yield less mire-essence' - no licensed form, the third tell event stands Theme-less and the gap is recorded.
adjudication.notes: The attitude scaffolding, calendar terms, definite-referent projection, compound decomposition and the sealed collective 'form a closed loop' (one event, four Agent atoms, indefinite loop witness kept inside) are all correct; the defect is confined to the three sealed complements. All three sentences fail the same way, so this is one construction gap reported three times rather than three independent errors.
